fix: Load the JWT signing secret from an environment variable or secret manager and rotate the exposed value.
Use a parameterized query such as LIKE $1 with the value '%'+q+'%' passed in the params array.
Apply path.basename to the name (or reject separators and parent-directory segments) and verify the resolved path stays inside REPORT_DIR.
Hash passwords with a slow salted algorithm such as bcrypt, scrypt or argon2 instead of MD5.
Validate the URL against an allow-list of hosts and block private, loopback and link-local addresses before fetching.
Add requireAdmin or an ownership check so users can only delete tickets they are permitted to delete.
Use execFile with an argument array and validate format against an allow-list instead of interpolating into a shell string.
